about: Today's Sky Devotion for La Porte, Indiana, picked each morning by what the sky is doing (devotion/sky.js). By La Porte Weather Now. Scripture: KJV (public domain). Weather: National Weather Service.
forecastLine: Today: Partly Sunny, high near 77°. Tonight: Mostly Cloudy, low around 57°.

entry.kjv: Who is among you that feareth the LORD, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD, and stay upon his God.
entry.text: Isaiah wrote to people walking without much light, and he didn't tell them to pretend. He told them to trust and lean on God. On a dim day, lean a little harder, and let someone lean on you.
